Ghost — Sorrow-bound (CV 25)

A translucent human figure in rain-soaked clothing, its expression fixed between grief and accusation. Details of its appearance belong to the last unresolved moments of its life.

Attributes: Brawn -1; Fortitude +0; Agility +1; Guile +1; Knowledge +1; Reason +2

HP: 16 · Speed: 6 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 2

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (2)\ Immunities: Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Main ActionsDefenseDamage
Basic MeleeAgility5/3/2
AccusationReason5 + Dazed 2 / 3 + Dazed 1 / 2
ManeuversEffect
Spectral PassageMove up to 2 squares through nonliving walls, finishing in a visible legal empty space. Cannot cross living bodies or remain in a wall. Provokes on leaving reach; does not bypass a ward expressly barring spirits.
Defend+1 Bane
ReactionsEffect
Answering LamentAfter taking HP damage: a hearing attacker within 3 gains Frightened 2.
Opportunity AttackBasic Melee

Details

Accusation

For a moment, the victim remembers a pain that has not happened yet.

Target: One visible creature within 5 squares. Player defense: Reason. Damage type: mental.

Weak defense: Dazed 2. Standard defense: Dazed 1.

Spell: Provokes when cast beside an enemy.

Answering Lament

Its outline shudders with the injury and a grieving note rises from somewhere behind the attacker.

After an attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, one visible attacker within 3 squares that can hear it gains Frightened 2 of this creature. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. Frightened applies only while this creature is perceptible.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Lifeless Body: does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

Anchor Bound: Its rain-soaked letter identifies the witness. Reading it aloud while holding it costs Main and removes the ghost’s physical DR until the reader’s next turn. Repetition renews, not stacks. A summoned ghost has no anchor; dies at 0 normally.

Healing: Spirit: ordinary magical HP healing applies; potions cannot be swallowed.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: One room remains cold and wet whatever the weather.

Purpose: Have the truth of its death heard.

Tactics and retreat: Pass through a wall to escape pressure, then use a mind-hammering accusation.

Counterplay and conversation: Find the person or evidence named in its repeated question.

Habitat: House; ruin · Communication: Languages known in life

Loot: Revealing the truth may open an inheritance or hidden cache.

Summoning: Spirit 3 — @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.61a10ca9b23399d9.JournalEntryPage.f75d0459c1b8e797]{player reference}.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-sorrow-ghost

Category: Spirit · Role: Haunter · CV: 25

Difficulty rationale: An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 2/3/5

Reference type: mental

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.65

Action review (#1279): U 1.55 → 1.65: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=2.404, O=3.653. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
